relationships.subject: Δ9-THC
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis showed that the expression of PPARγ, clathrin, and β-adaptin was upregulated in both cancer cells by Δ9-THC treatment

relationships.subject: Δ9-THC
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis showed that Δ9-THC treatment also upregulated BAX and downregulated BCL-2

relationships.subject: Δ9-THC
relationships.evidence_quote: Δ9-THC treatment increased the expression of p53 tumor suppressor protein

relationships.subject: GW9662
relationships.evidence_quote: the increased expression of vesicle formation-related proteins, such as clathrin and β-adaptin, was decreased by coadministration with GW9662

key_findings: Δ9-THC inhibits proliferation and induces apoptosis/necroptosis markers in SW480 and LoVo colorectal cancer cells.
Δ9-THC induces intracellular vesicle formation via PPARγ-dependent clathrin upregulation, reversed by GW9662.
